findings.finding: The workflow editor has real task, validation, and approval nodes plus typed port connections, but only always, never, source-present, and source-truthy edge conditions. Decision, branch, merge, loop, subflow, event, recovery, comparison-rule, default-branch, and visible branch-outcome contracts are absent.

Durable approval, pause, resume, interruption, failure, and recovery behavior exists behind the UI, but the canvas projects only a pink approval border, a checkbox, and generic lifecycle actions. Cancellation at the host approval boundary emits no typed acknowledgement.

The node trace overlay reads only top-level result.node_receipts while durable status and list operations return checkpoint.node_receipts. Trace identity is not revision/run-bound, polling or subscription is absent, and start replaces the canvas before a useful live overlay can appear.

studioEditorPayload removes node.position into editor_layout, but workflow parsing, the authority envelope, immutable revision records, and catalog reload do not persist or reload that layout sidecar.

additional_blockers: Exact resume depends on the currently paged catalog instead of an authenticated exact subject/version fetch.
Browser and Python identity normalization, version allocation, derived catalog fields, and ephemeral draft/run boundaries are not represented by one lossless payload contract.
Current dashboard E2E selectors target obsolete edge endpoint attributes and do not prove the current editor path.
bounded_repair_order: Separate executable definition, authority, editor layout, ephemeral run input, durable run state, and derived catalog metadata, all revision-bound.
Define closed branching and trace projection contracts together.
Repair immutable version allocation, exact lookup, draft restore/discard, and save/reopen equality.
Project approval, cancellation, interruption, failure, and recovery states onto the canvas.
Bind durable trace to workflow ID, version, revision hash, and run ID and read checkpoint receipts.
Repair exact resume and authority-editor round-trip.
